rationale: The workflow already caches Docker build layers via the GitHub Actions cache (cache-from/cache-to type=gha, scoped per matrix image) in the docker/bake-action step, which is the dependency-cache equivalent for this image-build workflow. The evaluated dependency-caching evidence (P-LIT-GHA-CACHE experiment) concerns language package caches keyed on lockfiles (pip/Go modules/Ruby bundler); this workflow installs no language dependencies and already caches Docker layers, so adding actions/cache would not apply and risks duplicating cache logic. Matrix fail-fast is already false and each image build is a required output, so enabling cancellation is not supported. A custom job timeout lacks representative duration history (ci_history reports no completed runs). Cancel-superseded runs conflicts with image publishing/release work in the same per-ref concurrency group. No safe, evidence-supported optimization applies without weakening coverage or adding risk, so the workflow is unchanged.
